title: chore(changeset): backfill changesets for post-9.3 changes
body:
Backfills the changesets missed for package-touching PRs merged after the objectui SHA pinned at framework **9.3.0** (`e95cc25`).

Scanned every non-merge commit in `e95cc25..HEAD`; grouped the changeset-less ones into coherent units:

| Package(s) | Bump | Change |
|---|---|---|
| `plugin-gantt` | minor | year scale / nav / saved layout / PDF export (#1706) |
| `plugin-gantt` | minor | configurable tooltip + live parent-stretch (#1689) |
| `plugin-chatbot` | minor | inline AI `data-chart` rendering (#1712) |
| `plugin-chatbot` | minor | honest turn-liveness indicator (#1699/1700/1702) |
| `app-shell` | minor | AI workspace UX — date grouping / split / shortcuts (#1703/1705/1707/1709) |
| `app-shell` | patch | send current-page object to AI assistant (#1698) |
| `app-shell`+`plugin-list`+`plugin-grid`+`data-objectstack` | minor | ADR-0047 interface pages (#1678/1680/1681/1684/1685/1691/1694/1695/1704) |
| `plugin-list` | patch | gate speculative `$select` by real schema (#1710) |
| `app-shell` | minor | ADR-0048 package-id app routing + prefer-local (#1688/1693/1696) |
| `app-shell` + `core` | minor | zero-roundtrip `newTabUrl` fast path (#1675) |
| `plugin-report` | minor | server-supplied dataset matrix totals (#1669) |

Test-only commits and `chore: bump objectui` pins were skipped. `npx changeset status` resolves cleanly.
